digest.component_or_area: LLM model configuration and environment variable handling
propositions: REBAR_LLM_MODEL environment variable must be deprecated via _scheduled() in _deprecations.REGISTRY with a permanent=False migration window to remove_in=_MAJOR (v1.0.0), replacing it with per-class model configuration
The deprecation warning must be emitted at both env-read sites: config.py:469 and a new read in model_classes.py during slot resolution, each with its own warn_deprecated call
When REBAR_LLM_MODEL is set and no per-class models are configured, it must map to all three model classes as a fallback default

Documentation references in README.md, docs/config.md, docs/llm-framework.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md, docs/workflow-authoring-v2.md, and generated docs/env-vars.md must be updated to present class-based configuration instead of REBAR_LLM_MODEL as the current interface
Example configurations for Anthropic-only, Bedrock-only, mixed-provider, and local+fallback setups must be added to docs/ as complete [tool.rebar.llm.model_classes] tables

The deprecation comment in _deprecations.py:75-79 must be corrected to distinguish between permanent renames (the existing six entries) and scheduled supersessions (this new entry), explaining why REBAR_LLM_MODEL uses _scheduled not _permanent
